name: dsh-web-mobile-pmsfh
description: Standalone mobile web page for DSH (v2.0 rewrite): the host half serves a self-contained mini chat app at /_dsh-web-mobile/ that talks directly to the same wire protocol as the official SPA (unary POST /api/<method>, WS /api/events.mux, POST /api/respond). The client half only redirects coarse-pointer narrow-viewport browsers to the mobile page (sessionStorage-scoped escape hatch). The old CSS-overlay approach is retired. Zero main-repo changes.
